metadata.name: rfc1918-infra-control-plane
metadata.description: Repo-safe control-plane contract for SLURM/Jenkins/DistCC CI/CD, Nexus publication, RFC1918 CA packages, and NetBox-driven DNS propagation.

variables.name: repo_root
variables.description: Repository root for source-of-truth, scripts, docs, and workflow manifests.

variables.name: ansible_root
variables.description: Ansible root containing inventories, roles, and playbooks.

variables.name: inventory
variables.description: Local-network inventory for Nexus, Jenkins, SLURM, DNS, and client rollout paths.

variables.name: control_plane_contract
variables.description: Declarative contract tying CI/CD, repositories, CA packages, and DNS propagation together.

stages.summary: Refuse live publication or DNS mutation if the source-of-truth repository is dirty or out of date.
command: git diff --quiet && git diff --cached --quiet && git status -sb

stages.summary: Validate that Ansible Vault identity material is loaded through the repo wrapper before any live playbook runs.
Render the Jenkins controller profile with the RFC1918 infrastructure seed manifest; this does not create live jobs by itself.
command:
printf '%s
' 'Render vm-jenkins-controller and verify /var/lib/jenkins/seed-manifests/rfc1918-infra-control-plane.yml before enabling a seed job.'

stages.summary: Plan CI build execution through SLURM with DistCC metadata and no ad-hoc local package publication.
command:
printf '%s
' 'Jenkins job seed submits build stages to SLURM, consumes distcc_farm metadata, and publishes only through approved repository stages.'

stages.summary: Plan RFC1918 CA package builds for Gentoo and Rocky/RHEL repositories without embedding private key material.
command:
printf '%s
' 'Build app-misc/rfc99-atlasforge-ca-certs and rfc99-atlasforge-ca-certs RPM from public CA cert material; publish via Nexus only after CI validation.'

stages.summary: Validate Nexus hosted repository intent for Gentoo overlay, Gentoo binpkgs/raw artifacts, and RPM/Yum packages.
command:
test -f profile-definitions/vm-nexus-repository.yml && test -f roles/nexus_repo/templates/nexus-proxy-intent.yml.j2 && printf '%s
' 'Nexus repo intent exists; live API repository creation remains gated on vaulted admin credentials.'

stages.summary: Dry-run NetBox authoritative host/IP data through Hetzner DNS planning and CoreDNS local split-horizon render paths.
command:
printf '%s
' 'Dry-run chain: NetBox -> scripts/plan-hetzner-dns-from-netbox.py -> scripts/apply-hetzner-dns-plan.py --check -> playbooks/coredns-resolver.yml render/reload gate.'
